prompt: A startup of five engineers is about to build its first product and asks whether to start with microservices. Which answer matches the course?

choices.text: Yes, because splitting later is impossible
choices.why: Splitting later is the usual path.

choices.text: A monolith in modules, until the boundaries settle
Serverless functions, so there is nothing to operate
choices.why: Functions still have to be operated and paid for.

choices.text: A service per noun, so each can be rewritten
choices.why: That is the premium paid too early.

choices.text: All three change, or none does

choices.text: The linter forbids every join in Python
Two modules can never share a database
choices.why: In a modular monolith they share one, each owning its tables.
